context: M27 o3. (Nick.) Varelas showroom. Wurtz runs a finger down a mink. Brannock behind him.

lines.speaker: char.dennis_wurtz
lines.text: Mr. Varelas. Insurance man's been asking about July twenty-sixth. Our night.

lines.speaker: char.dennis_wurtz
lines.text: My memory's for sale. Five thousand. Seasonal price.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Everybody gets paid, Lieutenant. You'll have it Friday.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: His man by the door has a skim, Delphine says. A man with a skim has a price.
